0022600030.text: The Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the East) host the Raptors (4-4, 5th in the East) in their ninth game of the season, with Milwaukee at 1-3 at home. Milwaukee is without Kam Jones (ankle), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes is day-to-day with groin soreness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Toronto won the last meeting 122-94 in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series the Bucks lost 1-3.
